blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines –Despite Alas Pilipinas’ ninth-place finish, Angel Canino and Bella Belen ended their first Asian Games stint with plenty of promise as two of the brightest young stars of the women’s volleyball team. The Philippines arrived in Japan with a goal of reaching the quarterfinals and getting a shot at a medal. But after going winless in Pool B against eventual champion China and Kazakhstan, Japanese coach Taka Minowa gave the team a new mission: win all three classification matches and finish the tournament strong.
